purpose: Exclude the full independent-port GL(3,C)^6 orbit of qutrit affine-support quadratic-phase tensors by an exact cut-rank invariant.

candidate_class.name: QUTRIT_AFFINE_QUADRATIC_PHASE
candidate_class.definition: f(z)=lambda*1[z in a+L]*omega^{Q(z)} over F3, with lambda nonzero, L linear, omega a primitive cube root and degree(Q)<=2.
candidate_class.scope_note: This is one precise stabilizer-type tractable candidate family; it is not asserted to exhaust asymmetric domain-3 Holant.

power_of_three_flattening_theorem.name: AFFINE_QUADRATIC_PHASE_CUT_RANK_IS_A_POWER_OF_THREE
power_of_three_flattening_theorem.statement: For every bipartition X|Y, the complex flattening rank is 3^r.
proof: Affine translations and pure-X/pure-Y/linear phases only permute or nonzero-diagonally scale rows and columns.
For linear support L, with K_X=L intersect (X+0), K_Y=L intersect (0+Y), U=pi_X(L), V=pi_Y(L), support membership induces U/K_X isomorphic to V/K_Y and hence 3^c block-diagonal support blocks.
Inside each block, after row/column phase removal, the matrix is M_B(u,v)=omega^{B(u,v)} for the cross bilinear form B on K_X x K_Y.
Distinct additive characters indexed by im(beta), beta(u)=B(u,.), are linearly independent, so each block rank is 3^s.

portwise_orbit_invariance: Independent invertible bases T_1 tensor ... tensor T_n multiply every named flattening by invertible Kronecker matrices on left/right, preserving rank.

janus_certificate.obstruction: 6 and 12 are not powers of three.

killed: Mapping F6 by independent invertible qutrit port bases into one affine-support quadratic-phase/stabilizer-type tensor.
Every edge-compatible gauge specialization of that single-tensor route.
not_killed: Polynomially closed sums of affine-quadratic-phase tensors.
Order-sensitive graph-global contraction using Hamiltonian port order.
A direct polynomial evaluator with witness reconstruction.

next_target.name: E8_C4_ORDER_SENSITIVE_TRANSFER_ALGEBRA_OR_STABILIZER_SUM_V8_5_8
next_target.directive: Test exact local factorization and global closure. Any representation change that returns bijectively to the original 12-state quotient must be frozen as an anti-loop, not promoted as an algorithm. Then attack order-sensitive global contraction.
